info.description: Domain registration for agents, paid in USDC on Solana via x402 (Musebook facilitator, exact scheme): availability checks, pinned price quotes, registration and renewal, and DNS management through the Porkbun registrar. Paid endpoints answer HTTP 402 with a PAYMENT-REQUIRED challenge when unpaid; the payer wallet proven by the settled payment is recorded as the domain owner. Domains are held under the operator's registrar account with WHOIS privacy — ownership is the service ledger entry, not the WHOIS record.
info.title: Clawd Domains

get.description: Returns the service descriptor: name, network (Solana CAIP-2), USDC asset mint, payTo revenue wallet, facilitator URL, registrar in use, and fee schedule.
get.summary: Fetch the Clawd Domains service descriptor

post.description: Free availability check. Returns availability plus registrar cost, service fee, and total price in USDC. Rate-limited per client IP.

domain.description: Fully qualified domain name to check.

get.description: Lists the domains whose recorded owner equals the given payer wallet.

parameters.description: Owner wallet address (base58) recorded at registration.
parameters.name: owner

get.summary: List domains owned by a wallet

get.description: Lists current DNS records for the domain. Free — DNS is public data.

post.description: Creates, edits, or deletes one DNS record. x402-gated at a flat DNS fee (default 0.05 USDC); the settled payer must equal the recorded domain owner, otherwise 403. If the registrar write fails after settlement, a refund-owed entry is booked and the call answers 502.

id.description: Record ID (required for edit and delete).

name.description: Subdomain host part; empty string means the root domain.

type.description: Record type: A, AAAA, CNAME, TXT, MX, etc.

200.description: DNS write applied; response carries the PAYMENT-RESPONSE settlement header.

402.description: Payment required — PAYMENT-REQUIRED header carries the x402 challenge priced at the flat DNS fee.

403.description: Payer is not the recorded domain owner.

404.description: Domain is not registered through this service.

409.description: Payment already redeemed (a payment redeems exactly once).

502.description: Registrar write failed after settlement; refund booked in the service ledger.

post.summary: Create, edit, or delete a DNS record (paid, owner only)

get.description: All-TLD pricing from the registrar, converted to customer USDC prices: registration and renewal each shown as registrar cost, service fee, and total.

post.description: Issues a price quote pinned for 120 seconds: quoteId, registrar cost, service fee, and total in USDC. Only available domains can be quoted.

200.description: Pinned quote with quoteId and expiry.

post.description: Registers the quoted domain. x402-gated at the quote's totalUsdc; the payer wallet proven by the settled payment becomes the recorded owner. The registrar is only called after settlement confirms, and the live registrar price is re-checked first — if it rose beyond the configured tolerance, or registration fails after settlement, a refund-owed entry is booked in the service ledger and the call answers 502.

200.description: Domain registered; ownership recorded to the payer wallet. Response carries the PAYMENT-RESPONSE settlement header.

402.description: Payment required — PAYMENT-REQUIRED header carries the x402 challenge priced at the quote total.

409.description: Payment already redeemed (a payment redeems exactly once).

502.description: Registration failed after settlement; refund booked in the service ledger.

post.description: Renews a domain registered through this service, following the same quote + gate flow as registration (renewal price pinned server-side, then charged). The settled payer must equal the recorded owner, otherwise 403. Post-settlement registrar failures book a refund-owed ledger entry and answer 502.

200.description: Domain renewed; new expiry recorded. Response carries the PAYMENT-RESPONSE settlement header.

402.description: Payment required — PAYMENT-REQUIRED header carries the x402 challenge priced at the renewal total.

403.description: Payer is not the recorded domain owner.

404.description: Domain is not registered through this service.

409.description: Payment already redeemed (a payment redeems exactly once).

502.description: Renewal failed after settlement; refund booked in the service ledger.
